description:
When a Beadwork goal ends, drop `run` mode and forget the session's open minions group.

## Background

If `run` sticks after the epic is closed, the standing appendix keeps telling the parent to orchestrate. If the group is not forgotten, the next `/bw run` joins a stale group (old cwd, old path intent).

## Behavior

- `beadwork_close_issue` of the **scoped epic** exits run (drop appendix) and requests minions group halt+forget. Beadwork must not import minions internals. Use the public halt tool/command if needed from the close handler, or document that the parent should halt — prefer a small in-process path only if both extensions already share Pi's tool registry. Simplest robust approach: on scoped-epic close, set session mode off run; inject a short prompt "goal complete; halt the minion group if any remain". Even simpler if halt is callable from extension code via the minions command handler... **Do not invent an event handshake.** Prefer: close_issue updates session state; prompt appendix disappears; inject a one-line prompt "Epic closed. Halt remaining minions and stop orchestrating." User abandon command (spelling is an implementation choice: e.g. `/bw abandon` or documented `/bw` subcommand) does the same plus halt live children.

- Halt of the group alone does **not** exit goal mode.
- Shell `bw close EPIC` is not watched; noticed on next parent refresh.
- Abandon: halt live children, forget group, exit run.

## Files

- `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/src/index.ts` close_issue path (after worker tools are gone)
- session-state
- commands for abandon
- tests

## Success criteria

- Close scoped epic → mode not run.
- Halt group → mode still run.
- After exit, next orchestrate (once minions exists) creates a new group — if you cannot call minions, test session state + injected halt instruction.

## Test plan

- Unit: close scoped epic vs close a ticket.
- Unit: halt does not clear mode.
- Unit: abandon clears mode.

## Considerations

index.ts hotspot: this issue is blocked by worker-tool deletion so both do not fight registrations. Do not reintroduce completionToken to close a group.
title: Exit goal mode on epic close or abandon and forget the minion group
